scope: Physical-GPU capacity preflight for the corrected H3 experiment
summary: The first corrected-run preflight correctly refused GPU 3 because only 42090 MiB was free, below the declared 60000 MiB minimum while unrelated jobs were active.
evidence: preflight-window-00-v1 measured 42090 MiB free against a 60000 MiB requirement and launched no model process.
lessons: Failing closed on measured physical-GPU capacity prevents an experiment from silently changing its memory contract or disrupting unrelated workloads.
limitations: No corrected H3 action was generated by this preflight.
next_actions: Wait for an eligible physical GPU and rerun the same 60000 MiB preflight without killing unrelated jobs or lowering the threshold.
